detector_params.note: Vol threshold 0.25 = proxy for VIX > 25 (1:1 monotone in practice). No VIX data on disk; realized-vol substitute used.

walk_forward.method: Per-year coverage validation against full_stack 5.5y replay
walk_forward.stop_framework: n/a — gate is binary suppression, not a stop

counterfactual_us_h2_family_2022.note: Gate skipped 67 of 71 trades in 2022 H2-family, eliminating -21.4R drag with zero impact on 2021/2024 bull years.

verdict_reason: Cleanly suppresses 2022-style bear market H2-family lanes (n=71→4 with -21.4R drag eliminated). No effect on bull years (2021/2024 0% risk_off). 2025 mid-year DD also caught (16.8% risk_off). Fail-open design: gate returns False if SPY data unavailable.
weight_meaning: n/a — gate suppresses trades to weight=0 binary, no continuous weighting
repro_command: cd src && .venv/bin/python -c 'from engine.regime.us_regime_gate import compute_regime_signal, is_risk_off'

lanes_NOT_gated_with_rationale.pa_us_dif_pos: Counterfactual 2026-06-09: 3 trades dropped in 2022 had net +0.44R positive contribution; regime gate would reduce EV. DIF>0 + h=opp natural filter handles bear regimes.
lanes_NOT_gated_with_rationale.all_CN_lanes: Different market regime; SPY-based gate not applicable

notes: Re-evaluate calibration if SPY-VIX relationship shifts (e.g. low-vol regime where SPY < SMA200 but realized vol < 25%). Quarterly check recommended via spy_regime.csv refresh.
